exact_statement: For every Boolean f on n coordinates and every order pi of [n]: H(f) <= [log2(4+e) + log2(pi^2/4)] I(f) + (2/ln 2) R_pi(f), where R_pi(f) = E_{S ~ fhat^2} sum_{j=1}^{|S|} ln(i_j/j) and i_1 < ... < i_|S| are the pi-positions of the elements of S.
proof_source: Gibbs on the level law with reference P(0)=1-v, P(k)=v(1-rho)rho^(k-1), rho=4/(4+e), plus Lemma levelentropy (valid for every Boolean f by edge-isoperimetry); Gibbs on each level with Q_k of main.tex l.524 and (2k+1)! >= 4^k (k!)^2. Validated on 3,240 (f, order) pairs, n=3,4, proved intervals.

exact_statement: For integers L >= 2, m >= 1 let f = prod_{b=1}^m AND_L(x_b) on disjoint blocks (+-1 valued). For every order pi of the mL coordinates, R_pi(f) >= 2^(1-L) sum_{p=1}^{mL} max{0, ln p - ln((L+1)/2 + (p-1) 2^(1-L))}; I(f) = mL 2^(1-L); H(f)/I(f) = H(AND_L)/I(AND_L) < 4; and liminf_{m -> infinity} min_pi R_pi(f)/I(f) >= (L-1) ln 2. Hence the right side of B19-RANKCODE-REDUCTION is at least (2(L-1) - o(1)) I(f) for every order while H(f) < 4 I(f): no single-order rank code proves FEI with a constant uniform over all Boolean functions.
proof_source: Per coordinate c at position p: ln(p/N_p) >= 0 with N_p = |S intersect pi^{-1}[1,p]|; Jensen gives E[1{c in S} ln(p/N_p)] >= P(c in S) max{0, ln p - ln E[N_p | c in S]}; P(c in S) = 2^(1-L); given c in S its block's other members are in S independently with prob 1/2 and other blocks are independent, so E[N_p | c in S] <= (L+1)/2 + (p-1) 2^(1-L). H(AND_L)/I(AND_L) <= 4 - [4 + 2(L-1)eps - 2(1-eps)/ln2]/L < 4 with eps = 2^(1-L). The liminf follows from the increasing integrand phi(t) = ln t - ln(c - q + q t). Checks: exhaustive over all orders for (m,L) = (2,2),(3,2),(2,3); certified rows L=4..32 (e.g. L=8, mL=1e9: rank term >= 13.99997 I vs H <= 3.8428 I).
refutes: any universal-FEI route that uses Theorem A's single-order rank code unchanged

exact_statement: Independent numerical re-check of the A056 disjoint composition identity accepted by A091: for uniform physical inputs and nonconstant, possibly unbalanced children f_i on disjoint blocks, with nu the induced product law of child outputs, Fhat(S)^2 = ghat_nu(A)^2 prod_{i in A} fhat_i(T_i)^2/v_i exactly, H(F) = H_nu(g) + sum_i a_i [H(f_i) - h2(v_i)], I(F) = sum_i a_i I(f_i), Var(F) = Var_nu(g), 0 <= a_i <= 1, a_i = I_i^nu(g)/v_i.
proof_source: code/exact_checks.py section C: 110 random compositions (k=2,3; block sizes 1-3), exact rationals plus interval entropies; all five identities pass. The proof is A056/A091's; this is evidence, not a new proof.
